summary: Changes safeGit so it no longer throws when git fails. It now returns a GitResult object with code, stdout and stderr, and index.ts exports the GitResult type.

findings.title: safeGit return change breaks both CLI callers
findings.problem: safeGit now returns a GitResult object instead of the stdout string. The callers in branch.ts and status.ts still call trim and split on that result.
findings.consequence: In branch.ts, currentBranch throws a TypeError, its catch swallows it, and it returns null even inside a repository. In status.ts, changedFiles throws a TypeError on every call.
findings.fix: Update both callers in the same change to check result.code and read result.stdout. currentBranch should return null when code is not zero.

findings.title: New safeGit failure path has no test
findings.problem: safeGit has a new error branch that turns a git failure into a returned code. No test in the repository exercises safeGit on success or on failure.
findings.consequence: A wrong code mapping or a broken caller could ship without anything failing first.
findings.fix: Add tests that call safeGit on a successful command and on a failing command. Assert code, stdout and stderr in each test.
